claims.claim: Scrap LG monitor and keyboard available for sale
claims.evidence: Photo shows monitor powered off; no way to confirm it is non-functional 'scrap' versus merely idle, and keyboard condition beyond visible wear cannot be judged from image alone.
Photo 0 shows LG logo on bottom bezel of monitor.
Photo 0 shows a keyboard in front of the monitor.

risks.risk: Monitor may not power on or display an image
risks.proof: Video of monitor being plugged in and turned on showing a live image

risks.risk: Screen panel may have cracks, dead pixels, or dents not visible in the single photo angle
risks.proof: Close-up photos of screen surface at an angle under light, and corners/edges

risks.risk: Keyboard may have missing or non-working keys beyond visible fading
risks.proof: Video of each key being pressed with on-screen character output

risks.risk: No power cable, video cable (VGA/HDMI), or stand screws may be included
risks.proof: Photo of all included cables and hardware laid out

risks.risk: Age and exact model unknown, affecting resale value and port compatibility
risks.proof: Clear photo of model/serial sticker on the back of the monitor

risks.risk: No CPU/tower or mouse included despite being a common bundle expectation
risks.proof: Seller explicit confirmation or photo showing absence
risks.if_unproven: priced as monitor and keyboard only

proof_requests: Video of monitor powering on with a live display
Close-up photos of screen surface and all casing edges/corners for cracks or dents
Video of each keyboard key being pressed showing character output
Photo of model/serial label on back of monitor
Photo of any included cables, stand screws, or accessories
response.reason: Witness confirms identity as an LG monitor and keyboard, so a worst-case price (treating function and condition as unverified/scrap) is possible even without power-on proof.
